statement: (∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, ∀ k : ℤ, KdVPlan.invD f k = (Complex.I*(k:ℂ))⁻¹*f k ∧ ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖ = |(k:ℝ)|⁻¹*‖f k‖ ∧ ‖KdVPlan.dx f k‖ = |(k:ℝ)|*‖f k‖) ∧ KdVPlan.MemH 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k:ℂ))⁻¹)
proof:
constructor
· intro f k
  have he : KdVPlan.invD f k = (Complex.I*(k:ℂ))⁻¹*f k := by
    by_cases h : k=0
    · simp [KdVPlan.invD, h]
    · simp [KdVPlan.invD, h]
  refine ⟨he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he]; simp [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_intCast]
  · simp [KdVPlan.dx, norm_mul, Complex.norm_intCast]
· have h := (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow (p := 2)).mpr (by norm_num)
  simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight, norm_inv, norm_mul, Complex.norm_intCast, sq_abs, ← inv_pow] using h
